A landscape painting: three big layered dark green pine forest hills under a warm candle-yellow evening sky, one big pale sun, a grey stone mountain peak behind. Only a few large flat shapes.

Style: a bold, simple illustration that will be displayed TINY as a framed picture on an office wall in a pixel art game (smaller than 64 pixels wide). Use large flat areas of strong saturated color, high contrast between neighbouring shapes, chunky iconic shapes and very few details; no thin lines, no small text. The artwork must fill the ENTIRE wide canvas edge to edge (full bleed), with no white or empty margins and no letterboxing: no frame, no border, no wall, no mat, no signature, no letters.

A pixel art scene of a cozy, empty timber lodge office interior at dusk, in top-down 3/4 view like a cozy management game. Wide dark pine plank floor; log walls; a lounge corner with a big grey stone fireplace with a warm fire, a fern green sofa with wool red cushions on a red and cream plaid rug; two islands of chunky wooden desks with glowing monitors, keyboards and mugs, dark chairs pushed in; potted ferns; tall wooden shelves with books and binders; a water cooler; a small coffee counter with a kettle. Big windows along the back wall show a deep green pine forest under a warm orange dusk sky. Warm candle-yellow lamp light pools on the floor. Calm, quiet, inviting atmosphere, nobody there: no people, no characters, no animals.

Style: authentic pixel art made of crisp hard-edged square pixels on a perfectly regular grid, limited palette, flat color fills with 3-4 shades per material, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur, no noise, no dithering. Cozy, warm timber lodge office pixel art with its own original look: dark pine log walls and plank floors (#5b3d2a), warm cream wool (#efe3c8), wool red plaid rugs and cushions (#b4473a), fern green armchairs and plants (#4f7d4a), grey stone hearth (#9a9488), deep forest green (#2f4a3a), soft candle-yellow lamp light (#f1c46b), glowing monitor screens. Original artwork: do not copy or imitate any existing game, tileset or artist. Outlines in dark blue-grey (#2b3245), never pure black. Light comes from the top-left. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermark.
